title: Mixing: I’m Moving On by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

A mixing session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 4 October 1980.

This session saw the completion of Ono’s song ‘I’m Moving On’. The song had been recorded on 12, 26, and 28 August, and 16 and 20 September 1980.
